answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the signal check immediately, the horizon audit keeps the resolved set and the terrace replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 135 aliases as a result pays the reading cost 135 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
